name: Salthe
source:
The star of this performance, known far and wide as the finest actress in Mersin's national theatre troupe.
Clever and competent, she has always balanced her stage work and her royal duties with skill.
Now she relives her time as Mersin's crown princess while searching for the reason for her death on Kloun's phantasmagoric stage.
